notes.title: Full reset soon
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, development has been stalled for several years due to various reasons, and the game is about to have a full reset.
Note: The purchase channel will remain open and the funds collected will be fully invested in the subsequent development.
Please continue to support the pole game, thank you!

notes.title: The next generation is coming
notes.notes: After a terrible time, I'm finally back to normal development, predicting a big version change around June 2024.

notes.title: Added a future game test
notes.notes: Enter the game and select the second option, which is a version of pure test code that will not be available until a year later, pure test minimalist.

notes.title: First Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952408/fdf2d5ee29d05451a6266e63638e6ebd177f1625.png[/img]
各位亲爱的steam玩家们，本次更新包含了可暂停继续播放音乐，可暂停以及继续游戏，菜单栏，加载画面（可能是一句话），显示系统时间，以及无尽模式，每次砖块归零都将继续刷新。
Dear Steam players, this update includes the ability to pause to continue playing music, the ability to pause and continue playing the game, the menu bar, the loading screen (maybe a word), the display of the system time, and the endless mode that refreshes every time a tile hits zero.

这个游戏是我的教学试验品，她的更新完全由玩家决定，如果各位有什么想法或者建议都可以通过评论或者以下网址bilibili找到我与我交流，比如说今天有粉丝私信希望加入可变化的球，安排了！很快会实现！
https://space.bilibili.com/51292260

This game is my teaching experiment, and its update is completely decided by the players. If you have any ideas or suggestions, you can find me through the comments or the following website bilibili to communicate with me. For example, today, there is a fan private message hoping to join the changeable ball, arranged! It will happen soon!
